definition: One idea; one visual plus at most one line. At most 6 words, at most 2 lines, type no smaller than 42pt. Pace 2-5 slides per minute.
examples: default for delivery_mode live-talk at its most spare, and for takahashi_lessig

definition: One idea in at most 3 chunks. At most 6 lines and 25 words, type no smaller than 30pt. Pace 1-2 slides per minute.
examples: default for delivery_mode live-talk and pitch
sources: research/03 §(c) level 2 (TEDx six lines; Kawasaki 30pt; Duarte glance test 3s)

definition: One message in at most 4 bullets of at most 4 information units each, at most 2 lines per bullet, at most 4 items per tree level. Roughly 40-60 words, body type no smaller than 20pt. Pace 1 slide per 1-2 minutes.
examples: default for delivery_mode briefing, teaching and workshop
sources: research/03 §(c) level 3 (Kosslyn et al. 2012 rule of four and 20pt minimum; Cowan 2001)

definition: One action title of at most 15 words (at most 8 in McKinsey house style) over 2-4 supporting points. Roughly 60-100 words, body 14-16pt. Executive summary 3 columns of 4-5 lines; dashboard 4-6 tiles; Harvey ball scorecard 3-4 options by 6-7 criteria; process at most 4-5 steps. Read, or 60 seconds per slide presented.
Multi-paragraph pages with several figures. 100 words per page target, 250 maximum; beyond 250 write a document instead. Not presented.
